module: Attention marker for a zone (polygon): instead of a 3D object, it asks the zone object to draw itself (zone:drawDebug('faded', color, fence height)). The color goes from blue (normal) to yellow then orange during a countdown, and to dark orange when the zone is "rising" or the countdown is finished. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/zoneAttention')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: setToCheckpoint(wp) accepts either a zone object (fields drawDebug and vertices), or wp.zone; otherwise only wp.pos and wp.radius are stored and nothing is drawn.
The center is zone.center or the position of the first vertex; if a terrain exists, the height is snapped back to terrain + 2 m (core_terrain).
The fence is drawn with alpha 0.25 and height fenceHeight (0.33 by default, adjustable with setFenceHeight).
C:setCountdown actually has the signature (remaining, total, done); the extracted page shows (total, done) because it omits the first parameter: the first argument is the remaining time.
The extracted page shows update(dtSim); the actual signature is update(dt, dtSim).

init.desc: Constructor: initializes the state (invisible, mode 'hidden', blue color).

update.desc: Per-frame call: computes the target color (blue, yellow-to-orange gradient during the countdown, dark orange if rising or finished), smooths it then draws the zone.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Associates the zone to draw, or a simple position if wp is not a zone.

wp.desc: Zone object {drawDebug, vertices, center?}, or {zone = ...}, or {pos, radius}.

setFenceHeight.desc: Sets the height of the drawn fence.

h.desc: Height in meters; nil keeps the current value.

setCountdown.desc: Sets the countdown state that drives the color.

done.desc: true when the countdown is finished (dark orange color).

setRising.desc: Marks the zone as "rising": dark orange color.

createMarkers.desc: Kept for API compatibility: creates no object.
